{{Top|leg}}
'''Mission 759/B''' was the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] survey of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] conducted by [[Imperial Survey Corps/Legends|survey]] team [[IX3244-B]]. The report concluded that Endor was a viable location, and that the native [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] were primitive and not a threat.<ref name="Report">{{WEGCite|story=Report to Imperial Command|book=The Star Wars Sourcebook|reprint=1}}</ref>
